issue.title: ysqlsh and t-server crashed/aborted while running DDL in CLI tool to create tables

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
after recent rolling restarts - I created new YSQL database and start running simple DDL create table/index script and while doing it - client (and t-server) crashed/aborted,. See below screen output and FATAL log:

yugabyte=# \i '/root/Downloads/storage-br_CMSDBSelection/_10_CreateDB.postgresql.sql'
CREATE DATABASE
yugabyte=# \i '/root/Downloads/storage-br_CMSDBSelection/_20_CreateUsers.postgresql.sql'^C
yugabyte=# \i '/root/Downloads/storage-br_CMSDBSelection/_20_CreateUsers.postgresql.sql'
CREATE ROLE
yugabyte=# \c CMS
You are now connected to database "CMS" as user "yugabyte".
CMS=# \i '/root/Downloads/storage-br_CMSDBSelection/_22_CreateSchema.postgresql.sql'
CREATE TABLE
CREATE INDEX
GRANT
GRANT
CREATE TABLE
CREATE INDEX
GRANT
GRANT
GRANT
ysqlsh:/root/Downloads/storage-br_CMSDBSelection/_22_CreateSchema.postgresql.sql:50: server closed the connection unexpectedly
        This probably means the server terminated abnormally
        before or while processing the request.
ysqlsh:/root/Downloads/storage-br_CMSDBSelection/_22_CreateSchema.postgresql.sql:50: connection to server was lost
[2]+  Aborted                 (core dumped) nohup ./bin/yb-tserver --flagfile /var/lib/yugabyte-2.0.1.0/tserver.conf &>/var/lib/yugabyte-2.0.1.0/yb-tserver.out
